test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Suman invested a sum of Rs. 20,000 at 10% per annum compound interest. If she received an amount of Rs. 26,620 after n years, the value of n is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 20,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Amount = Rs. 26,620

Time = n years

**Formula used:**

Amount = Principal × {1 + (R)/(100)}Time

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Amount = Principal × {1 + (R)/(100)}Time

⇒ 26,620 = 20,000 × {1 + (10)/(100)}ⁿ

⇒ (26,620)/(20,000) = {1 + (1)/(10)}ⁿ

⇒ (1331)/(1000) = {(11)/(10)}ⁿ

⇒ ((11)/(10))³ = ((11)/(10))ⁿ

⇒ n = 3

Hence, The required value of n years is 3 years.
